architecture_pattern: Clean Architecture / Hexagonal Architecture (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Api)
search_engine: Dedicated Search Engine (Elasticsearch / Meilisearch) synchronized via domain events
messaging_broker: RabbitMQ with MassTransit (Domain Events, Outbox Pattern, Saga State Machines)
auth_provider: JWT Bearer Tokens with ASP.NET Core Identity & Role-Based Access Control (Customer vs Admin)
realtime_engine: ASP.NET Core SignalR with Redis Backplane
cache_and_state: Redis 7 (Distributed cache, SignalR backplane, session state)
orchestration_and_observability: .NET Aspire (Shopizy.AppHost & Shopizy.ServiceDefaults for orchestration, OpenTelemetry, health checks, service discovery)
high_concurrency_inventory: Hybrid: Redis atomic Lua script reservation during flash sales, confirmed via PostgreSQL Outbox transaction
read_scalability: Full CQRS: Separate read and write pipelines with Redis response caching and search engine offloading
cloud_deployment: Azure Container Apps / Serverless containers with built-in KEDA scaling (RabbitMQ queue depth + CPU/Memory)
testing_framework: xUnit, FluentAssertions, Moq, Respawn, Testcontainers & WebApplicationFactory
